title: Your Coding Agent Is 6 Months Out of Date — Jakub Hojsan, Exa
description:
Every model ships about six months behind its knowledge cutoff. Your code review agent is reviewing changes it has never seen.

Jakub Hojsan, forward deployed engineer at Exa, explains how Exa built search for coding and code-review agents. He walks through a real PR that falls in a model's blind spot, shows why just adding a web search tool doesn't fix it, and explains how to give your agent rules for when to search. He also covers query-dependent highlights that cut a 100,000-character page down to about 500 characters with no added latency, and previews Exa Agent.

In this talk:
• The knowledge-cutoff gap and why it breaks code review
• Why agents need explicit rules for when to search, not just a search tool
• Token-efficient highlights: giving the model only what it needs
• Transparency, cost and model-provider independence versus built-in web search
